title: Inbound analytics request taxonomy and responder playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a defendable, low-friction taxonomy and responder playbook for inbound console/reporting requests from enterprise customers (usage exports, cost breakdowns, ad-hoc dashboards, and custom telemetry). Goal: reduce mean time to first response, match request type to the correct responder tier (self-serve, Solutions Engineering, Eng Ops), and provide deterministic prioritization so large customers get predictable SLAs without overwhelming engineering queues.
routing_rules_summary: Score requests by (1) customer tier and contract SLAs, (2) scope (one-off export vs persistent dashboard), (3) data sensitivity (PII/PHI flags), and (4) estimated engineering effort. Map high-score items to Concierge lane (Solutions Eng + Eng Ops), medium to Product-managed backlog with template responses, low to self-serve or docs. Include automatic routing to Dedicated support when tenant has reserved capacity and export needs exceed 10M rows per month.
acceptance_criteria: Define a 6-class taxonomy covering: Quick explain, One-off export, Scheduled export, Custom dashboard, Billing dispute investigation, Telemetry product request
Publish responder playbook with deterministic routing matrix and SLAs for each class (1 business day for Quick explain, 3 business days for One-off export, 10 business days for Custom dashboard)
Implement intake form changes in Console (new fields: estimated row volume, intended recipient, data sensitivity, desired recurrence)
Create a triage scoring script (non-prod) to validate routing decisions against 120 sample requests
Onboard Solutions Eng + Support with runbook and escalation paths; record a 30-minute async training video and checklist
